title: Why your muscles SHAKE on the last rep 🫨
caption:
That shake on your last rep isn't your muscle breaking. It's your nervous system calling in bigger motor units as the small ones tire. Do you shake on the last rep? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #1
first_comment: Which exercise makes YOU shake the most? 🫨
sources: Henneman E. Relation between size of neurons and their susceptibility to discharge. Science 1957;126:1345 (size principle: small motor units first, bigger ones added as force is needed)
Enoka RM, Duchateau J. Muscle fatigue: what, why and how it influences muscle function. J Physiol 2008;586:11-23 (fatigue raises recruitment and makes force less steady)
Lippold OCJ. The tremor in fatigue. Ciba Found Symp 1981;82:234-248 (physiological tremor grows with fatigue)
